description: Standardized geometric and topological descriptor dataset for 2D carbon allotropes.

delta_e_ev_per_atom.description: Computed DFT-D3 relative formation energy per carbon atom relative to pristine graphene.

area_per_atom.description: Planar unit cell surface area divided by total number of carbon atoms in the cell.

atomic_area_density.description: Number of carbon atoms per unit planar surface area (natoms / planar_area).

in_plane_ratio_b_a.description: Aspect ratio of in-plane lattice parameters (b / a).

lattice_gamma.description: In-plane lattice angle between vectors a and b.

buckling_height_angstrom.description: Out-of-plane vertical atomic span along z-axis (max(z) - min(z)).

bond_length_mean.description: Mean C-C bond length in the 2D periodic network within 1.85 Å cutoff.

bond_length_std.description: Standard deviation of C-C bond lengths.

bond_length_span.description: Difference between maximum and minimum C-C bond length (max - min).

bond_angle_mean.description: Mean C-C-C planar bond angle across all adjacent triplets.

bond_angle_std.description: Standard deviation of planar C-C-C bond angles.

bond_angle_msd_120.description: Mean Squared Deviation of bond angles from ideal 120.0° planar sp² geometry: (1/M) sum (theta_i - 120)^2.

bond_angle_rmsd_120.description: Root Mean Squared Deviation of bond angles from ideal 120.0° planar sp² geometry.

mean_coordination.description: Average atomic coordination number in the 2D periodic network.

fraction_coord3.description: Fraction of atoms with strictly 3-fold coordination (sp² planar sites).

ring_entropy.description: Topological Shannon entropy of ring size distribution: - sum_k f_k * ln(f_k).

fraction_ring_6.description: Fraction of 6-membered carbon rings (benzenoid hexagonal motifs).

non_hexagonal_fraction.description: Fraction of topological rings that deviate from standard hexagons (1.0 - fraction_ring_6).

stone_wales_fraction.description: Combined fraction of 5- and 7-membered rings (Stone-Wales defect motifs).

leakage_prevention_guideline: Train and cross-validate exclusively on the 53 canonical allotropes using GroupKFold(groups=crystal_system). Never evaluate on duplicate aliases as test samples.
